updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Integration with Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to intercept and inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, enabling organizations to enforce DLP policies on sensitive data flowing through browsers, apps, APIs, and generative AI platforms. This prevents data leakage to untrusted cloud applications while maintaining compliance visibility.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Safeguards for Copilot Web Search
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP is expanding to prevent Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data detected in prompts for external web searches. This real-time control mitigates data leakage and oversharing risks by blocking Copilot responses when sensitive information is present.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP for Copilot in Government Clouds
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP protection for Microsoft 365 Copilot is rolling out to government clouds, safeguarding prompts containing sensitive data by preventing response generation or grounding when sensitive information is detected. This extends sensitive data controls to government tenants using Copilot.

updates.title: Azure Key Vault Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability (CVE-2026-62825)
updates.summary: An improper authentication vulnerability in Azure Key Vault allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network. Admins managing identity and secrets infrastructure should apply available patches immediately.

updates.title: Microsoft Exchange Online Tampering Vulnerability (CVE-2026-56191)
updates.summary: An improper authentication flaw in Microsoft Exchange Online permits unauthorized attackers to perform tampering over a network. Organizations should prioritize patching to prevent unauthorized modifications to mail data and settings.

updates.title: Azure DNS Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability (CVE-2026-58275)
updates.summary: Missing authorization controls in Azure DNS allow unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges over a network. This affects DNS resolution and identity-dependent infrastructure; patches should be applied promptly.

updates.title: Online Services Information Disclosure Vulnerability (CVE-2026-62835)
updates.summary: Improper authorization in Online Services enables unauthorized attackers to disclose sensitive information over a network. This broad vulnerability affects Microsoft 365 services and requires immediate investigation and patching.

updates.title: Sensitivity Labels for Microsoft Entra Security Groups
updates.summary: Administrators can now apply sensitivity labels directly to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups, extending classification and governance controls already in place for Microsoft 365 groups without requiring separate label configuration. This unifies labeling policy across identity objects and collaboration groups.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP SLA-Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new out-of-box dashboard for DLP alerts provides MTTA, MTTD, and MTTR metrics with customizable SLA thresholds for alert severity levels. Admins gain visibility into operational performance and can identify top exposed Sensitive Information Types to improve incident response efficiency.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Rule-Based Alert Tagging and Auto-Resolution
updates.summary: DLP administrators can now define rules that automatically tag and resolve predictable alerts, reducing triage queue noise by filtering low-severity or trusted-domain alerts and categorizing others for faster routing. This automation improves alert management efficiency without removing compliance visibility.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Auto-Labeling Scale Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Microsoft is increasing maximum auto-labeling capacity from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day for SharePoint and OneDrive, enabling organizations to classify and protect more data at rest faster. This helps admins close labeling gaps and prepare data governance for Copilot integration.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Enriched Audit Data for Matched Rules
updates.summary: DLP audit records for Exchange Online policy violations now include enriched metadata such as sender domain, subject keywords, attachment type, and recipient information alongside Sensitive Information Type matches. Admins gain deeper insight for compliance monitoring, incident investigation, and policy tuning.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management Unified Alert Experience
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now combines the Triage Agent and Standard alert dashboards into a single unified alerts list, allowing analysts to manage classic and agent-triaged alerts together with direct access to agent summaries and user profile details. This streamlines alert triage and investigation workflows.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk User Profile Enhancements
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now displays expanded user profile signals from Microsoft Entra in the alert experience, including office location, employee type, department, and last working date. This enriched context helps analysts better assess risk and respond to alerts with user-aware perspective.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management Expanded Note Capabilities
updates.summary: Analysts can now add and view notes on both alerts and cases in Insider Risk Management, with system-generated notes automatically applied on status, assignment, closure, or escalation changes. This enhances collaboration and audit trail for investigation teams.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLM Archive Support for OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: Data Lifecycle Management now enables administrators to include file archiving actions within retention policies for SharePoint Online and OneDrive, moving inactive content to low-cost storage while maintaining compliance and discoverability. This extends DLM governance beyond retention and deletion.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLM Hard Delete via Secure Priority Cleanup Workflows
updates.summary: Data Lifecycle Management is adding hard delete capability for OneDrive and SharePoint through secure priority cleanup workflows, allowing compliance admins to permanently remove content beyond the standard 93-day recycle bin retention. This provides stronger enforcement of data removal policies while maintaining legal safeguards.
